summary.text: Son of Sthenelus son of Capaneus; last sole king of Argos before Orestes seized the city — Pausanias says he died without offspring, ending the line that had reunited the three kingdoms.

story.text: When Amphilochus migrated after Troy and Cyanippus died childless, Sthenelus son of Capaneus had already inherited Iphis' third of the kingdom. His son Cylarabes then held Argos united — but he too left no heirs, and the neighbouring Orestes son of Agamemnon took the city.

Pausanias still knew his name on the ground at Argos: the Cylarabis, the race-course in the city, and a gymnasium of Cylarabes where an Athena called Pania was worshipped, with graves shown of Sthenelus and of Cylarabes himself.
